text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
W-Wah! That's amazing! I guess that's what 
makes it the haunted house everyone's... 
t-talking about!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan, tell us how you feel right now! 
What part is scary? Where do you sense 
that creepy vibe!?

A trembling Kitasan Black, and Machikane 
Tannhauser taking notes on the situation. 
As for how things ended up like this, it 
all started a few hours ago—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
How to make haunted houses not scary, is 
it?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I wanted to make it the main 
attraction for the 'Shopping District 
Grand Appreciation Festival' I mentioned 
before, but I'm having a hard time making 
it properly scary.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"The greengrocer who always looks out for 
me was in a pinch! So I tried to help out 
too, but... somehow, I could only come up 
with totally plain ideas!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
A-A haunted house... A haunted house, 
huh...! ...Aw, heck with it!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I-In that case, let's research scary 
things! It's okay...! I'm terrified of 
ghosts anyway!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Precisely because I'm a scaredy-cat, 
my experience should be useful! I'll 
definitely be able to help out!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I want to see everyone's festival! That 
single-minded desire is within me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I'm so sorry~! Thank you so much! 
But please let me know if it gets to be 
too much!

And so, I set out on a study of terrifying 
things to find hints for improving the 
haunted house, but――

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
W-Well... it's alright so far~ The blue 
light is kind of pretty too~ ...or 
something.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, do you hear something? Like... a 
child's voice?
『……Let’s play tag……！』

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaagh! Zombies, zombies, zombiiies!!! 
Eeeeek, there are so many of theeeem!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
N-Numbers! You're scared of being chased 
by numbers, aren't you~?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Man, that was terrifying...! No wonder 
everyone's talking about that movie!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Reflected in the window, a smile... 
long hair... And then, what else was 
there... Ugh!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I can't even look out the window at night 
anymore! Or under the bed... or in the 
bathroom mirror...!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
That smile and hair reflected in the 
glass... Y-You're so right! Just 
remembering it makes my handwriting 
shake...!
choice_data_list: Maybe you should stop for now...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
N-No! I'm still good to go! Come on, let's 
do the next one while I'm still 
conscious...!

Even though she was scared, Kitasan Black 
endured it for the shopping district 
folks. Taking breaks along the way, she 
gathered ideas...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
A-A-Alright...! If we use these as a 
reference, we're sure to make a terrifying 
haunted house...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so much...! Thanks to you, I 
got tons of hints! All that's left is—"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
Guh! After everything that's been done for 
me, I won't let anyone say it was useless! 
Just wait right there!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
All right, tune-up finished...! Give me 
your honest thoughts!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Our final duty... Everyone's spirit—I 
shall accept it with all my heart!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Eek! S-Someone was just peeking through 
the window...
Uwaaaaaaaaah!!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Noooo!? It—it's chasing meee!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: K-Kita-chan and everyone!? Are you okay!?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
I heard a scream, but... H-How did it... 
go?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That was so... so scary!! Man, my heart is 
pounding like crazy!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Just when you thought there was nothing, a 
ghost was standing there quietly with a 
smile! And at the end, a whole bunch of 
them chased after us!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! This is guaranteed to be a 
huge success! You have my personal seal of 
approval!

This is the result of pushing through your 
fear!

This is the reward for doing your best 
despite being scared!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yes! This passion and dedication—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Most of all! When we're having fun 
ourselves, that feeling will reach the 
audience too!"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... Thanks. You've helped me so much 
up to this point! I'll definitely make 
this festival a blast!

Watching the lively banter between the 
shopping district folks and Kitasan Black 
warmed the heart.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Th-That's right! Even weaknesses can come 
in handy once in a while...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: However... um...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
When we go to the festival for real... 
Please stay by my side, okay...?
